items.t: 2-year-old suffers catastrophic brain injury after exposure to 7-OH
items.x: An Indiana 2-year-old suffered a catastrophic brain injury after police say he was exposed to a drug called 7-OH.

items.t: ‘All My Children’ actor Alan Dysert dead at 75 following incurable cancer diagnosis
items.x: Actor Alan Dysert, known for his role in “All My Children,” died at age 75.

items.t: Microsoft offers a quarter of its global workforce voluntary buyouts as AI spending accelerates
items.x: Microsoft has offered 60,000 employees, or about 27% of its global workforce, voluntary buyouts as the software giant spends heavily on artificial intelligence.

items.t: A fire at a seafood plant in Oregon forces evacuations amid fear of ammonia exposure
items.x: People in a small coastal city in Oregon were evacuated when a fire erupted at a seafood plant and it was feared ammonia tanks could rupture and send dangerous amounts of the chemical into the air.

items.t: Couple arrested after children found living in what sheriff called a ‘house of horrors’
items.x: A West Virginia couple faces child abuse and neglect charges after three children reported years of alleged abuse, authorities said.

items.t: Leon County Schools confirms 4 students were injured in the shooting on Saturday
items.x: Leon County Schools confirmed on Monday that, as of now, four students were injured in the shooting on Perry Street on Saturday.

items.t: Local organizations address youth gun violence after Perry Street shooting injured four students
items.x: Four students were hurt in Saturday's Perry Street shooting, and groups like Omega Lamplighters are addressing youth gun violence head on.

items.t: First Alert Daily: An above-average end to October 📲
items.x: The last week of October is looking above average as temperatures climb into the low-80s. Meteorologist Cameron Aaron has an update on our warming trend plus a potential increase in rain chances by Halloween weekend.

items.t: Anthropic AI bot accessed public Georgia voter data through state data hub
items.x: State officials say the bot used Georgia’s public data hub and did not access the voter file or voter registration system.

items.t: Teen accused in Tallahassee mass shooting will be tried as an adult
items.x: A 15-year-old charged with 11 counts of attempted second-degree murder in the Perry Street mass shooting will be tried as an adult.

items.t: Gas under Trump 2.0 is now more expensive than it was under Biden
items.x: Gas is now more expensive under President Trump than it was during the Biden era, according to a CNN analysis of AAA data. Here's what's driving prices at the pump. 👇

items.t: What is ‘moneymaxxing’ and how can it help your budget?
items.x: "Moneymaxxing" is a viral trend about making every dollar work harder. A wealth advisor explains how to get started, and when to know you've gone too far.

items.t: Detected: How artificial intelligence is changing breast cancer detection
items.x: AI is now helping radiologists read mammograms, flag subtle changes, and catch cancers earlier. National Consumer Investigator Rachel DePompa shows how it’s being used today, and why doctors say it must remain a tool, not a replacement.

items.t: Walter Koenig, Ensign Chekov on original 'Star Trek' series, dies at 90
items.x: Actor Walter Koenig, who played Ensign Pavel Chekov, the youthful Russian navigator on the " Star Trek " television series and several movies, has died. He was 90.

items.t: ‘Star Trek’ actor Walter Koenig dies at 90, reports say
items.x: "Star Trek" actor Walter Koenig, who played Ensign Pavel Chekov, has died at 90 in North Hollywood, reports say.

items.t: Cause of death revealed for Eric Bauza, the modern voice of Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and more
items.x: Eric Bauza, the Emmy Award-winning voice actor who was the modern voice of Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and many more Looney Tunes characters, died suddenly at the age of 46, his family said.

items.t: By the numbers: Georgia’s daily early voting totals ahead of the November election
items.x: Early voting kicked off across the Peach State on Oct. 13.

items.t: ‘I get very angry’: Valdosta mother speaks out after son’s shooting as family seeks help
items.x: he mother of a 10-year-old boy shot in the face by a 9-year-old in September says she has not been told of a court date in the case, and that the mother of the boy involved still lives a few houses down from her.

items.t: Former hairstylist and nail tech battles lung cancer after decades of chemical exposure
items.x: Hairstylists across the country are reporting adverse reactions ranging from burns to cancers connected to hair care products.

items.t: Judge rules Maurene Comey, daughter of ex-FBI director, was unlawfully fired by Trump administration
items.x: Maurene Comey, the daughter of former FBI Director James Comey, was unlawfully fired from her job as a federal prosecutor in New York last year, a federal judge ruled Monday.
